variables.description: Columns to check. Empty means every column.

keys.description: Key columns that together must identify a row (customer ID, order number). Checked for duplicates, blanks and lost leading zeros.

required.description: Columns that must be filled in every row (ID, email). Blank cells are listed.

overview.description: Data overview: rows, columns, duplicate and incomplete rows, column types (dlookr::overview).

diagnose.description: Per-variable type, missing count and percentage, distinct values (dlookr::diagnose).

maxExamples.description: Example values or rows shown per problem.

names.description: Column-name problems: duplicates, names differing only in case or spacing, names R renamed on import, automatic names for blank headers, leading/trailing spaces, special or garbled characters, names starting with a digit, mixed naming styles.

nameStyle.description: Naming style to expect for ASCII names: auto (the majority style), snake (snake_case), camel (camelCase) or any (don't check style).

emptyRows.description: Rows where every cell is empty.

constant.description: Columns with a single distinct value.

numberText.description: Text columns that are mostly numbers: values with thousands separators or units ('1,000원') and non-numbers ('N/A', '공란').

dates.description: Date columns stored as text with mixed layouts (2026-10-19, 2026/10/19, 19-Oct-2026), impossible dates, ambiguous day/month order, dates before 1900 or far in the future, Excel date serials.

leadingZeros.description: Fixed-width codes (IDs, zip codes) with mixed widths, i.e. leading zeros lost when a spreadsheet read them as numbers.

numeric.description: Numeric summary with counts of zeros, negatives and outliers (dlookr::diagnose_numeric).

outliers.description: Outlier count, ratio and mean with and without outliers per numeric variable, by the 1.5 x IQR rule (dlookr::diagnose_outlier).

outlierPlot.description: Box plots with each value as a point, outliers in red, for variables with outliers.

outlierRows.description: Row numbers and values of outliers, farthest from the median first.

rareLevels.description: Values that are rare in a column with few categories (possible typos).

rareShare.description: A category value is rare below this percentage of rows.

ranges.description: Range rules: each value of the variable must lie within [min, max].

min.description: Lowest allowed value (number or YYYY-MM-DD); empty for no lower bound.

max.description: Highest allowed value; empty for no upper bound.

values.description: Allowed values separated by commas or |, e.g. '남, 여' or 'Y|N'.

order.description: Order rules between two columns, e.g. 주문일 <= 배송일, 시작일 <= 종료일. Dates and numbers stored as text are parsed.

summary.description: Count NA values in the summary.

pareto.description: Pareto chart of missing percentage per variable with dlookr's missing grades (plot_na_pareto).

hidden.description: Values that stand for missing without being NA: empty strings, text codes, numeric codes at the column's minimum or maximum.

codes.description: Codes that mean missing. Text codes match ignoring case; numeric codes count only when they are the column's minimum or maximum.

rows.description: Rows identical in every checked column.

keys.description: Rows sharing the same key (needs keys).

whitespace.description: Leading/trailing spaces, doubled spaces, invisible spaces (no-break, ideographic, zero-width), tabs and line breaks inside values.

variants.description: Values that differ only in case, spacing or punctuation ('Seoul', ' seoul', 'SEOUL').

suspectSynonyms.description: Values in one column that probably mean the same thing, found without rules: known codings (남, 남자, M; Y, 예, O; 한국, KOREA) and, in columns with up to 30 categories, a Korean word and the same word with a short ending (서울, 서울시).

similar.description: Pairs of values one or two edits apart ('Busan', 'Busna'); adjacent swaps count as one edit.

maxDistance.description: Largest edit distance for similar spellings.

categories.description: Frequency table of the most common values per text variable (dlookr::diagnose_category).

topLevels.description: Values per variable in the category table.

variable.description: Column; empty for every text column.

values.description: Values with the same meaning, separated by commas, e.g. '한국, 대한민국, KOREA, 남한'. Matching ignores case and spacing.

to.description: The spelling to use; empty means the first value.

clean.description: Cleaned copy of the data (an export).

enabled.description: Make a cleaned copy of the data and save it in the R session. The original data frame is not changed.

trim.description: Trim and collapse whitespace in text.

hiddenMissing.description: Turn missing-value codes and empty strings into NA.

synonyms.description: Replace synonyms with their chosen spelling.

variants.description: Unify case/spacing variants to the most common spelling.

numbers.description: Convert text columns that are mostly numbers to numeric (non-numbers become NA).

dates.description: Convert date text in any detected layout to Date (unparseable values become NA).

padZeros.description: Pad fixed-width codes with leading zeros to their longest width (stored as text).

ruleViolations.description: Set values that break range or allowed-value rules to NA.

names.description: Make column names safe: trim, spaces to _, drop special characters, unique.

saveAs.description: Name of the cleaned data frame in the R session; empty to not save.

enabled.description: Write dlookr's HTML data diagnosis report to a file. Runs in a separate R process and takes tens of seconds (dlookr::diagnose_web_report).

format.description: web: interactive report with tabs (diagnose_web_report); paged: printable page layout (diagnose_paged_report, HTML).

file.description: Report file, relative to the working directory.
